- Yogurt cup, about 150 g, roughly 130 kcal.
- Banana, about 120 g edible, roughly 105 kcal.
- Latte-type drink in the mug, about 250 g, roughly 120 kcal if made with whole milk.
- Savory muffin with bacon or ham, about 90 g, roughly 280 kcal.
- Water, 0 kcal. I left its mass out of the total because it is not food.

Totals: 130 + 105 + 120 + 280 = 635 kcal. Mass: 150 + 120 + 250 + 90 = 610 g.
